negative_controls.verbatim: NEGATIVE CONTROL (gate disabled): On the identical silent-cast fixture whose permissive stop expression evaluates TRUE in round 1 with zero independent opening briefs, disabling the minimum-deliberation gate makes the run STOP in round 1. NEGATIVE CONTROL (false expression): A productive cast that meets every floor by round 2 must NOT stop via the floor when the stopping expression is `false`. The floor is a precondition on a satisfied stop, not a stop rule of its own.
